prompt: Where do you read the Oxygen version number?
Which view looks like a normal page while you write?
why: Author is the page view. Text shows tags. Grid looks like a spreadsheet.

prompt: Which side list jumps you to a paragraph in the current page?
why: Outline lists the pieces of the page. Attributes is the selected piece’s properties.

prompt: Which tree is the booklet, not the folder list?
why: Maps Manager is the booklet. Project view is files on disk.

prompt: In Adobe’s website tool, where do you make a web page?
why: Web pages are made in Sites. Maps Manager is Oxygen.

prompt: Which action sends a web page live in AEM without a long workflow?
why: Quick Publish is an AEM Sites action. Saving in Oxygen does not send a web page live.

prompt:
First real error in this snippet:
<concept id="x"><title>Assets & workflow</title></concept>
options: A concept cannot have a title
A raw & in the text breaks the tags
why: A raw & is not well-formed. The title is fine.

prompt:
First real problem:
A how-to page with no steps, only a paragraph that says “Just click OK.”
options: A how-to needs real steps, not a story paragraph
The id must be a number
How-to pages cannot have a title
why: A task is a procedure. Put the work in steps.

prompt: The booklet points at Topics/Hello Concept.dita but the file is topics/hello-concept.dita. First problem?
options: The path must match the real file name — spaces and capital letters often break it
Booklets cannot point at explaining pages
You must put the file on the desktop
why: Lowercase hyphens. Match the disk name.

prompt: Make a new explaining page with a writing toolbar.
why: The template gives Oxygen the right kind of page.

prompt: Open a page that already exists.
why: File > Open picks a file on disk.

prompt: Add a page to the booklet.
options: Maps Manager → right-click a line → Append Child → Reference
why: Append Child adds a pointer from the booklet to a page.

prompt: Check that every pointer in the booklet still finds a file.
options: Maps Manager → Validate and Check for Completeness
why: Completeness is a booklet check, not Help > About.

prompt: The draft site built, but a page is missing from the contents. First place you look?
why: If it is not in the booklet, it will not be in the site.

prompt: The PDF failed. First place you look?
options: The log, for the first real error
why: Read the first error. It is usually a missing file or a broken booklet.

prompt: A product name is not filling in on the page. First place you look?
options: Whether the root booklet is set, then the name defined in that booklet
why: Names in the booklet only work if that booklet is the root map.
